description: Defines message structures and enums related to channel switching, CAC notifications, and switch channel reports within the beerocks namespace for the prplMesh project.

classes.name: sSwitchChannelDurationTime
classes.description: Represents the duration expected for a channel switch.

classes.name: sSwitchChannelNotification
classes.description: Indicates whether a channel switch occurred and related info.

classes.name: sCacStartedNotification
classes.description: Contains data about CAC start event.

classes.name: sCacCompletedNotification
classes.description: Contains data about CAC completion event.

classes.name: sSwitchChannelRequest
classes.description: Request to switch to a specific Wi-Fi channel.

classes.name: sSwitchChannelReport
classes.description: Report summarizing the result of a switch channel operation.
